titleText: Ryanair changes policy for passengers who do not pay to reserve seats
mainText: From Times of Malta: Ryanair changes policy for passengers who do not pay to reserve seats. A revised seating policy gives the low-cost airline more time to assign seats to those who do not pay

titleText: McDonald’s invites fans to rediscover their inner Kevin with Home Alone Meals
mainText: From Times of Malta: McDonald’s invites fans to rediscover their inner Kevin with Home Alone Meals. The new holiday campaign features anything from collectible socks to festive events, trivia nights and seasonal rewards

titleText: 'Government continues burying head in sand over its economic model': PN
mainText: From Times of Malta: 'Government continues burying head in sand over its economic model': PN. Opposition says government ignoring warnings from its own experts

titleText: Spanish PM vows wealth tax ahead of election
mainText: From Times of Malta: Spanish PM vows wealth tax ahead of election. Polls have indicated the PP will win most seats in the election but fall short of a parliamentary majority

titleText: Ukraine claims responsibility for strikes on Russian ships off Libya
mainText: From Times of Malta: Ukraine claims responsibility for strikes on Russian ships off Libya. Volodymyr Zelensky says Ukraine used seven naval drones against the vessels
